column1: # One model per line: label, Hugging Face repo id, tensor-parallel size (= Gaudi
# cards), size class. submit_comparison.sh and prefetch_weights.sbatch read this
# file; blank lines and comments are ignored.
# All four are ungated Qwen instruction models, so the lineup isolates model
# size from model family, and all run under the vLLM build in ASU's shared
# gaudi-pytorch-vllm environment. Qwen3-30B-A3B is on Intel's Gaudi 2 validated
# list; the dense Qwen2.5 models are validated on Gaudi 3 and run on Gaudi 2
# through the same Qwen2ForCausalLM code path. Thinking variants are excluded
# because they spend the fixed 10000-token completion budget on reasoning.
# Weights in BF16 take 2 bytes per parameter and a Gaudi 2 card holds 96 GB, so
# the tensor-parallel size is the smallest card count that leaves room for a
# 32768-token KV cache. Swap in a gated model (meta-llama/Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct,
# TP 4) once HF_TOKEN is set in ~/.paperminertoolkit_env.
